text: Add guidance for choosing between Widget App Block and Widget App Embed
goal:
Update the APIEase docs project to document the new global widget app embed behavior and correct the existing widget theme setup guidance.

Context:
APIEase now has two Shopify theme extension surfaces for widgets.

The Widget App Block is still the normal placement-specific path. Merchants add it to a theme section or template, paste one widget handle into the Widget handle setting, and save. The app block does not require the App embed to be enabled.

The Widget App Embed now has a real purpose. It includes a Global widget handles setting. Merchants can enter widget handles, separated by new lines or commas. When the App embed is enabled, APIEase loads those registered widgets on every storefront page through the existing storefront widget endpoints. Returned Liquid can render globally, and widget JavaScript can run globally. This is intended for widgets that should run site-wide, such as floating widgets, popups, banners, tracking, or background storefront behavior.

Required docs changes:
1. Find the existing widget help docs that currently say to enable APIEase Widget App Embed as part of adding a normal widget to a theme.
2. Remove that App embed step from the normal Widget App Block setup instructions.
3. Make the Widget App Block instructions say:
   - Open Shopify admin and go to Online Store -> Themes.
   - Select Customize on the theme to update.
   - Navigate to the page or template where the widget should appear.
   - Add the APIEase Widget App Block block to the section.
   - Paste the widget handle into the Widget handle setting.
   - Save the theme changes.
4. Add a separate section for site-wide/global widgets using the App embed.
5. Explain that the App embed is optional and only needed for widgets that should run on every storefront page.
6. Document that Global widget handles accepts one or more widget handles separated by new lines or commas.
7. Explain that globally registered widgets should be designed for site-wide use. They may be non-visual background widgets or self-positioned visual widgets such as floating widgets, popups, or banners.
8. Warn merchants not to register ordinary section/content widgets globally unless they intentionally want them to load on every storefront page.
9. Update any related navigation/sidebar docs if a new page or section is added.
10. Keep wording merchant-facing and concise. Avoid implementation jargon except where needed to name Shopify surfaces: Widget App Block, Widget App Embed, and Global widget handles.

Suggested structure:
- Add a widget to a specific page or template
- Run widgets globally with the App embed
- Choosing between App Block and App Embed

Acceptance criteria:
- Normal widget placement docs no longer tell merchants to enable the App embed.
- App embed docs clearly describe the new Global widget handles setting.
- Docs clearly distinguish placement-specific widgets from site-wide/global widgets.
- Docs mention both newline-separated and comma-separated handles.
- Docs warn that globally registered widgets run on every storefront page.
- The docs build or relevant docs validation passes.

Validation:
Run the docs project formatting, lint, build, or test command that is already standard for the APIEase docs repository. If there is no obvious command, inspect package scripts and run the closest docs build/validation command.
context: Merchants need to understand when to use placement-specific widgets versus global widgets.
steps: Add a concise comparison section titled along the lines of Choosing between App Block and App Embed.
State that Widget App Block is the normal path for widgets that belong in a specific section, page, or template.
State that Widget App Embed is for site-wide widgets such as floating widgets, popups, banners, tracking, or background storefront behavior.
Warn merchants not to register ordinary section or content widgets globally unless they intentionally want them to load on every storefront page.
constraints: Avoid implementation jargon except where needed to name Shopify surfaces.
Keep the warning practical and merchant-facing.
acceptanceCriteria: The docs clearly distinguish placement-specific widgets from site-wide/global widgets.
The docs describe appropriate global widget examples, including non-visual background widgets and self-positioned visual widgets.
The docs warn against registering ordinary section/content widgets globally unintentionally.
